title: After a Difficult Loss, Nigeria Has Become a Source of Pain for Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
summary: Adichie has moved countless readers with her novels about Nigerians at home and abroad. After the death in Lagos of her toddler son, her homeland no longer feels as much like home.
